anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy apply when the report view changes workspace?

A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace's last filters.

Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler in `ui/report-view.ts` already preserves active filters. The resolver at `settings/resolver.ts:12` can own this behavior without per-workspace filter state. C would add that per-workspace state.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
How should the report view handle filters when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across workspace switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: C - keeps filters relevant to each workspace while preserving the user’s previous choices.
